title: delay
del
description: send a bang after a time delay

messages.description: set delay time and start the delay
set delay time for the next tempo

methods.description: set tempo value (float) and time unit symbol

body: [delay] outputs a bang after a delay time, set by the argument or the right inlet. A bang starts the delay and a float sets the time and starts it; restarting it while it runs reschedules the output, and 'stop' cancels it. Times are in milliseconds by default, which the 'tempo' message or the 2nd and 3rd arguments can change.
